meta.pipeline: recon -> hunter(parallel x2) -> skeptic -> referee -> fix -> verify

findings.claim: Signup auto-assigns role 'owner' to anyone registering with hardcoded owner emails (chandkris27@gmail.com / katchat369@gmail.com). No email verification exists, so anyone can become owner. The same block also interpolates raw email/username into supabase .or() filters and does no server-side email format validation (filter-injection / partial-match dup check).
findings.fix: Always assign 'member' at signup; validate email format server-side; use structured equality queries for duplicate checks; keep owner emails only as fallback display strings (never for role assignment).

findings.claim: Upload validation trusts client-controlled file.mimetype and derives the stored extension from file.originalname (attacker-controlled). An SVG/HTML payload with fake image mimetype is stored with a .svg extension and served from /uploads with inline CSP context and target=_blank links -> stored XSS against all users.
findings.fix: Validate magic bytes (JPEG/PNG/GIF/WebP signatures) inside fileFilter; derive extension from validated mimetype only; randomize filename with crypto; set X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff on /uploads.

findings.claim: socket events admin_ban_user / admin_unban_user have NO role check; any authenticated user can ban/unban anyone (data returned by a vulnerable admin endpoint supplies socketId).
findings.fix: Authorize via role permission canBanUsers; validate target user exists; sanitize reason.

findings.claim: notify_friend_request trusts client-supplied from payload and emits raw display_name/username to recipient -> spoofed notifications + stored-XSS vector via toast innerHTML.
findings.fix: Server looks up sender from socket userId; emit sanitized minimal fields.

findings.claim: Role name/color/icon accepted unvalidated and rendered into HTML (badge styles + onclick attributes) -> stored XSS via custom role creation (owner-only endpoint, but defense in depth + compromised owner).
findings.fix: Validate name ^[a-z0-9_-]{1,50}$, color #rrggbb hex, icon fa-* allowlist server-side; escape fields when rendering badges.

findings.claim: POST /api/messages/private/:userId and send_private_message do not require an accepted friendship -> anyone can DM anyone (abuse/spam vector).
findings.fix: Require accepted friendship (both directions) + canChat permission on REST and socket paths.

findings.claim: send_global_message ignores canGlobalChat permission; /ban /unban /tban commands only check role==='admin' (custom roles with canBanUsers cannot use them, and role string can be spoofed via DB anyway).
findings.fix: Enforce permissions loaded from roles table for global chat send and ban commands.

findings.claim: Error middleware returns { success:false, error: {...} } with an object payload -> frontend new Error(data.error) shows '[object Object]' and swallows real messages.
findings.fix: Return flat string error { error, code, statusCode }; frontend extracts String(data.error?.message ?? data.error).

findings.claim: Catch-all serves index.html (200 HTML) for missing /api/* and /uploads/* paths -> API 404s become HTML, breaking clients and hiding errors.
findings.fix: Exclude /api/ and /uploads/ from the SPA catch-all.

findings.claim: Math.max(...ids) on UUID announcement ids -> NaN; announcement notifications never trigger.
findings.fix: Track last announcement created_at timestamp instead of max UUID.

findings.claim: Global chat mention list calls admin-only /api/users/all -> members get 403, mention dropdown broken for non-admins.
findings.fix: Add GET /api/users/directory (any authenticated user; id/username/display_name/role/online) and use it for mentions.

findings.location: frontend settings.js applyAccentColor (sends key like 'cyan'); backend users.js:108 (requires hex)
findings.claim: Accent color update fails with 400; UI silently ignores.
findings.fix: Frontend converts ACCENT_THEMES h/s/l to hex before saving; theme resolution handles both key and hex.

findings.claim: Auto-unban triggers whenever temp_ban_until is in the past, even if an admin later applied a PERMANENT ban (permanent ban leaves stale temp_ban_until) -> banned users auto-unbanned.
findings.fix: Permanent ban clears temp_ban_until; auto-unban only when temp_ban_until is set and in the past.

findings.claim: Ban guard checks only req.user.role === 'admin' -> custom role with canAccessAdminPanel bypasses ban protections; also allows banning admins/owner.
findings.fix: Permission-based check (canBanUsers) server-side; non-owner cannot ban/unban admin or owner; owner cannot be banned.

findings.claim: Socket events have no rate limiting -> spam/flood vector.
findings.fix: Per-socket sliding-window throttle for messages; typing throttle 1/2s.

findings.claim: imageBase64 and messages arrays have no size caps; persisted into sage_history JSONB -> memory/DB abuse.
findings.fix: Cap messages (<=20, <=5000 chars), imageBase64 (<=8M chars), imageMime allowlist; per-user throttle.

findings.claim: Raw err.message returned in 500 responses -> leaks SQL/stack internals.
findings.fix: Return generic 'Server error' and log detail server-side.

findings.claim: must_change_password enforced only client-side; server change-password accepts currentPassword bypass via fromReset flag; admin-reset users can use all APIs freely.
findings.fix: Enforce must_change_password in REST auth middleware (allowlist /api/auth/*); change-password fromReset only honored when must_change_password is actually set.

findings.claim: Raw @target interpolated into 'User @x not found' error -> XSS via socket event payload.
findings.fix: Sanitize target chars; frontend escapes toast input.

findings.claim: Multer writes files BEFORE daily-limit check; on 429 the uploaded files are orphaned on disk.
findings.fix: Unlink uploaded files when rejecting with 429.

findings.claim: logError defined twice; error-handler.js default showUser=true toasts EVERY error incl. unhandled rejections -> toast spam.
findings.fix: Single definition; default showUser=false; explicit toasts where wanted.

findings.location: frontend ui.js:317-322, announcements.js:330-336 (image viewers), avatar crop
findings.claim: window mousemove/mouseup/keydown listeners never removed on close -> listener leaks (multiple duplicate viewers on re-open).
findings.fix: Capture handler refs and remove on close; remove keydown handler always (not only Escape).

findings.claim: When socket is null (reconnecting), message silently dropped.
findings.fix: Fall back to REST POST /messages/private/:id; toast on failure.

findings.claim: joins arbitrary conversation rooms with no participant check -> can watch any private conversation room.
findings.fix: Only join if uid is one of the conversationId parts.

findings.claim: substring ilike (%q%) matches wrong users and wildcard chars aren't stripped.
findings.fix: Exact username match with whitelisted chars [A-Za-z0-9_ .-].

findings.claim: Comments check only is_banned, ignoring canCommentAnnouncements permission.
findings.fix: Require canCommentAnnouncements permission (default member).

findings.claim: Frontend checks for 'once per day' but backend says 'You can only send one message per day' -> daily limit never surfaced.
findings.fix: Align check with backend string.

findings.claim: atob on base64url JWT payload breaks on unicode + is not URL-safe.
findings.fix: base64url-safe decode helper.

findings.claim: message_read can mark arbitrary conversations read (no participant check); typing events unthrottled/unvalidated.
findings.fix: Participant check on message_read; typing throttle 1/2s.

findings.claim: Raw cmdPart interpolated into onclick attribute -> command injection/XSS.
findings.fix: Escape with onclick-safe helper (onclickStr) or build with DOM + addEventListener.

findings.claim: Filenames use Date.now + Math.random + attacker extension -> enumeration + extension spoofing.
findings.fix: crypto.randomBytes hex + extension from validated mimetype.

findings.claim: GET /api/messages/global ignores page param -> pagination broken.
findings.fix: Apply range based on page.

findings.claim: delete-message with negative/non-integer messageIndex silently no-ops.
findings.fix: Validate integer bounds -> 400.

findings.claim: Raw email/username interpolated into supabase .or() filters (dup check) -> PostgREST filter injection.
findings.fix: Structured equality queries (see BUG-1 fix).

findings.claim: String equality secret comparison -> timing side channel.
findings.fix: crypto.timingSafeEqual on hashed inputs.

findings.claim: Math.random temp passwords -> predictable.
findings.fix: crypto.randomInt.

findings.claim: Help section bodies stored unsanitized -> stored XSS if owner account compromised (defense in depth).
findings.fix: Strip script tags, on* attributes, javascript: URLs server-side before storing.

findings.claim: UNIQUE(user_id, friend_id) doesn't prevent reverse-duplicate rows (A->B and B->A); concurrent requests create inconsistent duplicates; friend-request endpoint allows messaging non-friends via messageID leak.
findings.fix: Add pair-unique index (LEAST/GREATEST); catch insert conflicts gracefully.

findings.location: frontend ui.js showToast innerHTML sink + socket-client.js:40 toast reason
findings.claim: showToast interpolates raw msg into innerHTML; socket reasons/display names passed raw.
findings.fix: Escape msg in showToast (esc) — central sink fix.

fixSummary.verifiedBy: node --check (all backend+frontend files), live boot smoke test (health 200, auth 401, validation 400, catch-all 404), regression greps (.or() interpolations all UUID/whitelist-bound, no err.message 500 leaks, no silent catch()s)
